release_policy.rule: Only Qualified servers are release eligible. Connect-and-verify servers remain hidden from ordinary product discovery until authenticated tools/list, one safe backend read, and a Wright gateway call pass.

processes.engineer_task: Release an electronics BOM only after availability, lifecycle, lead-time, and alternate-part review.

mcp_roles.role: Read the reviewed schematic/PCB BOM and reference designators.
Analyze DigiKey/Mouser stock, lifecycle, lead time, compliance, packaging, and substitutes.

processes.handoff: Partuno receives normalized manufacturer part numbers and quantities; proposed substitutes return to an engineer for ECAD fit and approval.
approvals: Engineer approves each substitute and any distributor write action
limitations: Partuno backend data and Wright gateway remain untested without credentials
processes.next_qualification: Authenticate a read-only distributor test account, analyze a five-line synthetic BOM, and compare returned MPNs and quantities through the Wright gateway.

processes.engineer_task: Turn an approved requirement change into a traceable CAD revision and review package.

mcp_roles.role: Read the approved Jira requirement and linked Confluence rationale.
Apply a parameterized geometry change and export a review artifact.
Read or stage traceability between requirement, model revision, checks, and review.

processes.handoff: Requirement fields become named CAD parameters and deterministic checks; GitHub records the evidence only after explicit approval.
approvals: Engineer approves the requirement interpretation and external repository write
limitations: Atlassian and GitHub post-login tool schemas and gateway calls are not yet proven
processes.next_qualification: Use dedicated read-only projects to fetch one requirement and one repository file, then run the existing OpenSCAD fixture through Wright without external writes.

processes.engineer_task: Create a parameterized Onshape feature, evaluate the resulting part, and retain a reproducible design review.

mcp_roles.role: Generate or inspect FeatureScript in the official Labs service.
Exercise the reviewed Onshape document workflow and inspect resulting model properties.

processes.handoff: FeatureScript is reviewed as text before execution; the resulting part reference is passed to read-only model inspection.
approvals: Engineer approves generated FeatureScript before document mutation
limitations: Labs endpoint was proven only to its authentication boundary
processes.next_qualification: Authenticate, list tools, compile a minimal parameterized boss in a disposable document, and verify dimensions through Wright.

processes.engineer_task: Prepare a simulation case, submit it only after cost approval, monitor status, and review solver outputs against acceptance limits.

mcp_roles.role: Run the deterministic local FEA screening case and produce VTU evidence.
Read cloud job capabilities and status; submission remains approval-gated.

processes.handoff: The local baseline establishes numerical expectations before any paid cloud submission; result manifests are compared after completion.
approvals: Engineer approves solver, hardware, estimated cost, and submission
oracles: Cloud values agree with baseline within declared tolerance
limitations: No paid Rescale job or post-login tool call was run
processes.next_qualification: With a zero-cost or preapproved test project, list job types and read one existing completed job through Wright; do not submit work.

processes.engineer_task: Correlate a failed engineering automation run with dashboards, logs, alerts, and the owning change.

mcp_roles.role: Query read-only dashboards, alerts, Prometheus, and Loki evidence.
Read the workflow run and owning revision.

processes.handoff: The run timestamp and labels constrain telemetry queries; observations are linked to source history without changing alerts or dashboards.
approvals: No approval for reads; explicit approval for any issue or incident write
limitations: Grafana initialized and listed tools, but no backend instance was connected
processes.next_qualification: Connect a disposable Grafana instance with a read-only token and query one known metric and one known log stream through Wright.
